submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the head noun of a noun phrase that names a concrete story object, character, or place, when that noun phrase follows a determiner (a or the) in object position after a verb or preposition, such as a new telephone, a small voice, the baseball, or the king. It does not fire on the determiner or adjective before the noun, on verbs, or on non-noun words in the same slot.
